info.name: TaskFlow API Guard — Regression Automation Suite
info.description: 34-request, 170+ assertion Postman/Newman API regression suite validating Authentication, Task CRUD, Search/Filter/Sort, Cross-User Data Isolation, Profile Management, Dashboard Analytics, QA Endpoints, and Token Revocation.

item.name: 04. Register rejects invalid email & weak password (400)

exec: pm.test('User schema matches contract', () => { const u = pm.response.json().user; pm.expect(u).to.include.keys('id', 'uid', 'name', 'email', 'authProvider', 'createdAt'); });
pm.test('No token issued on failed login', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.not.have.property('token'));
pm.test('Returned user email matches User A', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().user.email).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('userAEmail')));
pm.test('Profile name matches', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().user.name).to.eql('API Guard User A'));

item.name: 17. GET single owned task by ID (200)
18. GET malformed non-numeric task ID returns 400

exec: pm.test('Invalid ID error returned', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.include('Invalid task ID'));
pm.test('All returned rows are completed', () => pm.response.json().tasks.forEach(t => pm.expect(t.status).to.eql('completed')));
